name: agent-charter
description: Build from the spec. Check against the source. Plugins for directing AI agents: fresh-context review, decision councils, best-of-n solutions, risk evaluation and a reasoning specialist.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Fresh eyes on any work (code against its spec, plans, decisions, documents, filings), judged from the governing sources and first principles.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Deliberation tools: a council of independent specialists for consequential decisions, best-of-n (compare n first-principles solutions, then build the winner), risk evaluation, and ask-specialist for one bounded, hard question.

plugins.name: figma-workflow
plugins.description: Figma to frontend for legacy server-rendered web apps: plan a screen from its Figma frame (new or changed), build it as a clickable no-backend prototype after one approval, and audit it independently against the design.
